ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_INTERLOPER_RUMOR_TEXT: The Interloper has not yet entered the solar system, and has not yet exploded.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_INTERLOPER_REVEAL_TEXT:
The Interloper's core holds a great deal of ghost matter. In the previous universe, it exploded as it neared the Sun, releasing ghost matter that killed the Nomai.

But right now, the Interloper has not yet entered the solar system.

Water shields land-dwelling creatures from ghost matter.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_GIANT_DEEP_SECRET_RUMOR_TEXT: The core of Giant's Deep was once a prison.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_GIANT_DEEP_SECRET_REVEAL_TEXT:
Daz shared this with me: the core of Giant's Deep once had an entrance. Behind it lay a “prison”, and anything that entered would be trapped inside, unable to move.

Daz advised me to stay away from there.

Inside the “prison”, the revival function fails.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_GIANT_DEEP_SECRET_ABSORBED_TEXT: You launched a singularity into the prison. It was absorbed, and the singularity remains at the core of Giant's Deep.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_REVIVE_DEVICE_RUMOR_TEXT: Revive at the ship or the Brittle Hollow base
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_REVIVE_DEVICE_REVEAL_TEXT:
Daz made a revival device for me. When I am in danger, I can revive at the ship or the Brittle Hollow base at any time.

She reminded me not to press the wrong button.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_SINGULARITY_LAUNCHER_RUMOR_TEXT: A singularity launcher rebuilt from a warp core
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_SINGULARITY_LAUNCHER_REVEAL_TEXT:
Daz added a singularity-launching function to the advanced warp core. I can launch black holes and white holes, and recall them.

The black hole's teleportation follows the host-exemption principle: an object that first becomes attached to a black hole will not be teleported.
ShipLogDictionary.RETURN_RIEBECK_PYE_THEORY_REVEAL_TEXT:
Daz: Remember Riebeck and Pye's theory? Object A falls into a black hole at time T, and its duplicate B emerges from the corresponding white hole earlier, at T − 0.0001 seconds.
Daz: Between T − 0.0001 seconds and T, two copies of the same object—A and B—briefly coexist in the universe. At time T, A falls into the black hole and becomes the causal origin of B. After time T, only B remains.
Daz: So the fabric of spacetime is not torn apart—unless someone closes or destroys either the black hole or the white hole between T − 0.0001 seconds and T.
Daz: Based on the memories you shared, we reached a new hypothesis: when an object in universe A falls into a black hole at time T, reality splits and produces a candidate universe B.
Daz: In universe B, the object never fell into the black hole; it simply emerged from the white hole at T − 0.0001 seconds.
Daz: Meanwhile, in universe A, if the object that emerged from the white hole fails to fall into the black hole at time T, its causal origin is severed. Universe A vanishes from the timeline, leaving only universe B.
Daz: If the object that emerged from the white hole does fall into the black hole at time T, universe A continues to exist, and the candidate universe B vanishes from the timeline.
Daz: If someone closes the black hole or the white hole between T − 0.0001 seconds and T, the fabric of spacetime is destroyed, because the object loses its causal origin in both universe A and universe B.
Daz: Based on this new hypothesis, we built the automatic revival device. No matter where I am, it can open a black hole and teleport my body back to the base.

DialogueDictionary.Revival will become impossible in <TimeM: Revival will become impossible in <TimeMinutesRemaining> minutes.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_01: COLEUS: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn’t be safe for the native life dwelling in some of this cave’s pools, so (unfortunately) we’ll have to mine one of the other sites.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_02: CYCAD: There are a few other cave sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and strata)?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_03: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_04: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_05: COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I imagine she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_06: CYCAD: What are you doing, COLEUS? What are you doing with those containers?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_MINE_07: COLEUS: I imagine my mentor, Melorae, would very much like to meet these adorable little creatures. I’m certain her good friend Daz would, too.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_STATUE_01: PHLOX: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_STATUE_02: YARROW: Daz, are you certain you don’t want to move that container—and the fish inside it—farther away?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_STATUE_03: DAZ: What are you suggesting? Do you actually believe a fish could pair with a memory statue?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_STATUE_04: YARROW: I’m merely accounting for the possibility.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_STATUE_05: DAZ: I believe you’re being needlessly cautious. I designed the statue’s memory storage system myself, and I made certain it would be incompatible with piscine memories. Besides, a fish’s memory lasts only seven seconds. We couldn’t extract anything useful from it even if we tried.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_STATUE_06: YARROW: Very well. The memory statue pairing test will now begin.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_01: DAZ: Who are you? Why did the memory statue pair with you? The statues should only be capable of pairing with terrestrial lifeforms.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_02: YOU: I come from the universe that existed before this one, and I carry memories of that time. Approximately 281,000 years after ghost matter killed your clan, the sun naturally went supernova. The Ash Twin Project finally activated, and I obtained the coordinates of the Eye. I completed the journey your clan had begun and explored the Eye of the universe in your place.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_03: DAZ: Stars above! Tell me—what is the Eye? What new knowledge did it reveal to you?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_04: YOU: By the time I reached it, the old universe was already dying. Its stars were going dark, and there was nothing I could do to save it. When I entered the Eye as a conscious observer, all those possibilities collapsed into a single outcome: the birth of a new universe.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_05: YOU: Perhaps I loved the old universe too dearly, because this new universe is almost exactly the same. The Nomai clan is still following the Eye’s signal, and I am once again a fish. Of course, 281,000 years from now, my species will evolve into the blue-skinned, four-eyed Hearthians, and I will be born among them. I will pilot my wooden ship through space and encounter the ruins you left behind.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_06: DAZ: Then the Eye was calling out to save us—to carry us beyond the end of the universe and grant us new life!
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_07: YOU: Not exactly. The Eye does not choose whom to save. It appears at the end of a universe and sends its signal across the cosmos, drawing every intelligent species toward it. Usually, the civilization wise and capable enough to reach it first becomes the final observer, and its memories determine the shape of the universe that follows. The Eye is both the end of one universe and the beginning of the next.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_08: DAZ: Then, if this universe is almost identical to the previous one, and you carry memories of that universe, those memories must include the coordinates of the Eye. Does that mean we could reach it immediately? I would dearly love to behold it with my own three eyes!
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_09: YOU: Of course. I can share the coordinates with you. There—now you know them. But shouldn’t you save your clan first? This universe still has approximately 281,000 years remaining. Your clan could have countless possibilities ahead of it.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_10: DAZ: Then I will follow your guidance, adorable little blue fish.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE4_QUESTION: Will you work with Daz to save the Nomai clan?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_01: DAZ: Our computer has pinpointed the comet’s location. Oh, you call it the Interloper? That is an excellent name.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_02: DAZ: We have it under observation. It is approaching our star system. Do you have a plan?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_03: YOU: I know the properties of ghost matter very well. It evaporates slowly, and its lethality can be blocked by water. Are you willing to follow every decision I make?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_04: DAZ: Of course. Our clan trusts you completely. You have our permission to transmit any of your thoughts through the memory statue in real time. I will carry out every one of your decisions without hesitation—even if I cannot understand it, and even if it costs me my life.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_05: DAZ: To prevent me from dying as a result of one of your mistaken decisions, the clan has constructed an automatic revival device. You are already familiar with the principle behind it.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_06: DAZ: Do you remember Ramie and Pye’s theory? Object A enters a black hole at time T, while its counterpart, Object B, emerges from the corresponding white hole at T minus 0.0001 seconds.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_07: DAZ: Between T minus 0.0001 seconds and T, two instances of the same object—A and B—briefly coexist within the universe. At time T, A enters the black hole and becomes the causal origin of B. After time T, only B remains.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_08: DAZ: The structure of spacetime therefore remains intact—unless the black hole or white hole is disrupted during the interval between T minus 0.0001 seconds and T.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_09: DAZ: The memories you shared with us have led to a new hypothesis. When an object enters a black hole at time T in Universe A, reality divides and produces a candidate Universe B.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_10: DAZ: In Universe B, the object never enters the black hole. It simply emerges from the white hole at T minus 0.0001 seconds.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_11: DAZ: Meanwhile, in Universe A, if the object that emerged from the white hole fails to enter the black hole at time T, its causal origin is broken. Universe A disappears from the timeline, and only Universe B remains.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_12: DAZ: If the object does enter the black hole at time T, Universe A remains stable, while the candidate Universe B disappears from the timeline.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_13: DAZ: If anyone closes either the black hole or the white hole between T minus 0.0001 seconds and T, the fabric of spacetime will be destroyed, because the object loses its causal origin in both Universe A and Universe B.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_14: DAZ: Based on this new hypothesis, we constructed an automatic revival device. From any location, it can open a black hole and transport my body back to our base.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_15: DAZ: You may activate the revival device manually at any time while I am still alive. Or, if I am close to death, you may wait for the Nomai computer to activate it automatically.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_16: DAZ: Our clan’s medical technology is highly advanced. As long as you still have a single breath left, we can restore you to full health and continue the journey.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_17: DAZ: Oh, no—not your body. Mine. As long as my body still has a single breath left.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_18: DAZ: And now, I surrender complete control of my body to you. I trust that you will use your knowledge to save us.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_19: YOU: Wait. After your body is teleported by the black hole, it returns to the candidate universe 0.0001 seconds ago. If I can't get you back into the black hole within 0.0001 seconds, you stay in the candidate universe, and the original universe disappears. Is that what it means?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_20: DAZ: Exactly. I resurrect in the candidate universe 0.0001 seconds ago every time, because it's very hard for you to return to the black hole within 0.0001 seconds.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_21: YOU: Then, are you still "you" before and after the teleportation?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_SCENE5_22: DAZ: That is not important. The "me" after teleportation only lacks 0.0001 seconds of memory compared to the "me" before. Whatever happens in that 0.0001 seconds is not enough to shape me into another person. I am always me.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_RECORDING2_01: When you pick it up, I believe you will understand: the truth is in your hands.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_RECORDING2_02: The truth allows you to launch one black hole and one white hole. The black hole follows the 'host exemption' rule: the first object it attaches to will not be teleported.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_RECORDING2_03: If you ask me what counts as an object, I will proudly answer: scouts, chunks of rock, planets, and even your ship.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_RECORDING2_04: Yes, you read that correctly. We can teleport an entire planet!
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_PORTAL_IMPACT_HINT:
You entered the black hole with an initial velocity. That initial velocity was the sum of your motion relative to the planet and the planet's own motion. Your velocity was preserved when you emerged from the white hole.

Therefore, before entering a black hole, consider whether that velocity will cause a fatal collision.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_01: DAZ: The Interloper is trapped in the core of Giant's Deep, and the water has blocked the Ghost Matter from harming the Nomai. You saved the Nomai.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_02: DAZ: Thank you, little blue fish. You saved us all.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_03: YOU: You really should thank yourselves. If you hadn't preserved an environment suitable for our survival when you first started mining, I wouldn't have had the chance to save you.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_04: DAZ: Stars above! What a beautiful deduction. Over the long ages, it was our own initial spark of reverence and kindness that completed a self-salvation across millions of years.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_05: YOU: Exactly. Just as you discovered with warp technology, cause and effect form a seamless closed loop. This is the truth the universe has taught us.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_06: DAZ: Speaking of which, after experiencing all this, what do you think the "Eye of the Universe" really is? Why did it send out that signal, sparing no effort to call us to it?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_07: YOU: Inspired by Ramie and Pye, I believe the Eye of the Universe is like a macroscopic, ultimate "black hole." When something enters it at a specific time (T), the timeline branches into the current universe and a candidate universe born prematurely at time (T-X) through a white hole.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_08: YOU: Perhaps the Big Bang that initially created everything was a giant white hole.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_09: YOU: The Eye sends the creature that enters it back 14.3 billion years (X = 14.3 billion), to a brand-new universe pouring out from the white hole, carrying none of our memories.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_10: YOU: But as the Ash Twin Project revealed, memory is the most precious thing of all. Stars will burn out and bodies will perish, but as long as something has been observed and remembered, its existence has meaning. Memory is the only defense against the void.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_11: YOU: The current universe refuses to be completely forgotten in the void. So, it released a signal through the Eye, summoning an "observer" capable of carrying the memories of all things to step inside at the end of time.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_12: YOU: When the observer of all things, carrying this universe's memories, enters the Eye (the black hole) at the end of the 14.3-billion-year cycle, this universe continues to exist. Stars erupt into supernovae one after another, providing exactly the energy to send the black hole 14.3 billion years back in time. The universe has never died; it resides in an eternal cycle. Reaching the Eye is the key to maintaining this cycle.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_13: DAZ: ...This hypothesis makes me feel a bit sad. Are you saying that our Nomai sacrifices across galaxies, our generational thirst for knowledge, and the curiosity we take such pride in, are simply underlying logic written by the universe to keep itself running?
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_14: YOU: No, Daz. It is not like that.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_16: YOU: Exploration and curiosity were never just survival traits attached to you.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_17: YOU: You yourselves are the physical embodiment of "exploration and curiosity" in this universe.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_VICTORY_DIALOGUE_18: YOU: It is your curiosity that gives the universe meaning, not the universe that defines you.
DialogueDictionary.$RETURN_PRISON_TRAPPED_HINT:
You are trapped inside the prison at the core of Giant's Deep.

Singularities absorbed by the prison cannot be recalled.
You cannot revive at the ship or the Brittle Hollow base from here.
Open the pause menu and choose "Meditate to the next new universe" to leave.
If you feel lost, check your ship log.

UIDictionary.$RETURN_DEATH_ENDING:
As the Interloper approached the Sun, its shell ruptured, releasing ghost matter and killing the Nomai clan.

You survived as a fish beneath the water, longing to save the Nomai once more in the next universe.
UIDictionary.$RETURN_DEATH_ENDING_2:
Although the Interloper did not explode in the solar system and release ghost matter, it drifted to another star system and killed the Nomai clan there.

 In the new universe, you plan to deal with the Interloper more carefully.
UIDictionary.$RETURN_TRUE_ENDING:
Outer Wilds was with me through the hardest time in my life.
At the time, I was backstabbed by a partner I trusted, felt malice everywhere, and lost hope in life.
Outer Wilds healed me through a dozen or so hours of play.

It taught me this:
We live in order to experience what is beautiful.
Exploring the unknown through science and experiencing the beauty of the universe—this is what my life should be made of.

People can be malicious, but the universe bears no malice. So my life must go on.

And so I am still alive today, still conducting scientific research in geophysics, and still writing novels.
I love science, and I love science fiction, because they are beautiful.

I spent more than ten hours making this game mod.
Before this, I had no experience in game development. I could not write C#, nor did I know how to use Unity.
I made this mod in the clumsiest way I knew and debugged 103 versions of it. It was exhausting.
But I believe it was worth it.

Perhaps being able to play Outer Wilds and so many excellent mods was an act of kindness the universe gave me.
I want to pass on the beauty I have experienced.
If you completed this story and are reading these words, thank you.

May your path through life be a gentle one.
